messages:
Alex W: Quick sync — I ran the paged-attn integration tests on canary and saw a 12-18% tail-latency regression for short-seq workloads when KV cache hit rate drops below ~70%.
Maria (ML): Yikes. Can you paste the flame output? Also which kernel was picked by the chooser?
Alex W: flame snippet below. chooser picked fused/flashv3 for short seq by default; fallback to paged only on OOMs.
Maria (ML): ```
# perf flame summary
gen_token: 120ms (p50=8ms p95=45ms p99=118ms)
attn_fused_forward: 64ms
attn_paged_forward: 38ms
kv_cache_lookup: 2ms
batcher_wait: 10ms
# observed under low KV hit load (0.42)
```
Tess (Perf): Interesting — fused kernel has higher single-op latency at scale when KV cache misses cause repeated recompute. Fused pulls whole window, paged avoids recompute. We need heuristics that consider KV hit-rate and avg seq.
Ben (EngRuntime): Proposal: add an attn_sampler feature flag (fflag attn_sampler_v1) that uses a probabilistic kernel sampler. Rules:
- if seq_len <= 128 -> prefer fused
- if seq_len >= 2048 -> prefer paged
- else choose fused with p = clamp(1 - kv_hit_rate, 0.1, 0.9)
Sam (SRE): How would rollout look? We need telemetry and quick rollback. Suggest canary on 5% traffic for 24h, auto rollback if p95 latency increases >10% for a route.
Ben (EngRuntime): + add metrics: kernel_choice, kv_hit_rate, per-route p95 delta. Also add a safety override that pins kernel to 'paged' when GPU mem pressure > 85%.
Maria (ML): One more datapoint — for mixed batch sizes, batching heuristics interact badly: when batching ups, fused gets better throughput but also longer stall bursts. We should expose batch_max_ms knob per route.
Alex W: Plan:
1) Implement sampler behind fflag (attn_sampler_v1) w/ config knobs: seq thresholds, kv threshold, mem pressure threshold, random seed.
2) Add kernel_choice metric and kernel_switch_count to tracing.
3) Canary to 5% for 24h; validate token-cost, p50/p95/p99, and correctness tests.
4) Ops runbook: fflag off -> immediate stable fallback to current chooser, emergency command /fflag off attn_sampler_v1.
Tess (Perf): I'll run synthetic microbenchmarks for shortseq/longseq with KV hit rates [0.2,0.5,0.8] and post numbers.
Sam (SRE): Deploy-bot started canary on i-ccd cluster. track id: cb-2026-09-15-01
deploy-bot: Canary deployment triggered: cb-2026-09-15-01 -> 5% traffic (attn_sampler_v1=on).
Ben (EngRuntime): Small config note — make default seed per-worker so sampling not fully correlated across batchers.
Alex W: Cool. Action items assigned: Ben implements fflag + metrics, Tess runs microbenchmarks, Maria updates model docs about fused vs paged tradeoffs, Sam watches canary. Re-check in 24h. :thumbsup:
